```python
import pixeltable as pxt
from pixeltable.iterators import FrameIterator

# Connect to pixeltable
pxt.client.connect()

# Get the existing videos table
videos = pxt.get_table('videos')

# Create a view that extracts frames at 1 fps
# Each row represents one frame from the video
frames_view = pxt.create_view(
    name='frames',
    select=videos.select(
        *videos.columns,
        frame=FrameIterator(videos.video, fps=1)
    )
)
```
